title: Which Is Missing? · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Which Is Missing? · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Lay out four objects, let the group see them, then cover them. The lead secretly removes one object and uncovers the rest; others identify the missing one. A player identifies the removed object. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Four household objects and a cloth; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Which Is Missing?, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
A player identifies the removed object.
recall.why: A player identifies the removed object.

game.materials: Four household objects and a cloth; a timer
